QuestInfo.name: I Will Light Your Way
QuestInfo.0:
The Earth Guardian seems to have an idea. 

Should you listen?
QuestInfo.1:
The Earth Guardian suggests hanging a lamp on a staff.
Then it'll light your way, and you won't be afraid.
He'll supply the staff, if you can bring out a lamp from your hut.

Would the lamp in #bfront of the entrance#k work?
Use a #rRegular Attack#k, with the #bDelicate Branch#k in your hand, to hit it. There's a good chance it will fall.

Since you own more than one lamp, you don't need to worry about leaving your home in the dark.
​
#r* You can get another [Delicate Branch] from the Earth Guardian if necessary. 
If you lose the item, forfeit the quest and try again.
QuestInfo.2:
You brought the lamp to the Earth Guardian.

With surprising grace for a seemingly clumsy animal, he hanged the lamp from the top of the staff.

With the light in your hands, you're no longer afraid of the unknown.

0.msg: Hey, Lynn! Like I said, talk to me again when get that lamp from your hut. I'll find a staff.
